description: NEXA-M2-003 retrieval gold set over the PNG STEM curriculum corpus. Questions are written in learner and teacher wording, not copied from the source. A retrieved chunk is a hit when it comes from one of the expected files and contains every evidence phrase (compared after lower-casing and collapsing non-alphanumerics). Categories: pdf_text, syllabus_outcome, docx_text, docx_table, pptx, ocr. Version 1.1.0 adds 16 Tok Pisin (tpi) questions that mirror English items: the question is in Tok Pisin and the answer is in the English curriculum (cross-lingual retrieval). Their evidence phrases stay English. The translations are drafts pending review by a Tok Pisin speaker; Hiri Motu items are still to be written.
